title: Charlie's Inferno
lyrics:
[00:06.34]Here lies Charlie
[00:09.15]You can tell it's him 'cause we put his name on the stone
[00:12.71]He kept his showers ice-cold, used eco-friendly lightbulbs
[00:16.35]Rode his bicycle to work when the gasoline price rose
[00:19.88]He'd judge with no pretense, fish on the weekends
[00:23.23]Each morning get up, do the Pledge of Allegiance
[00:26.16]Never swim in the ocean, for fear of shark attacks
[00:29.65]Bi-monthly get his wife a rose with a card attached
[00:32.99]Avoiding all the little things that were hard to ask
[00:36.33]Had a car crash, cardiac arrest, died of a heart attack
[00:39.66]Golden escalator, all his friends and neighbors
[00:42.67]Huddled there in prayer around the respirator
[00:46.25]"Catch you later, I'm off to see the man upstairs
[00:49.26]They all look like ants from here, stars and crystal chandeliers"
[00:52.40]There was an angel at the entrance, checking off a guest list
[00:56.27]Charlie wasn't on it, and was ushered to the exit
[00:59.43]His heart sank
[01:02.00]He was breathless
[01:05.57]"Excuse me, sir, there must be someone you've confused me for
[01:09.26]If I could see someone who knew me or someone in uniform
[01:12.43]I go to church on Sunday, truly, usually more"
[01:15.70]Screaming at the angels while they pushed him through the door
[01:19.05]"Excuse me, sir, there must be someone you've confused me for
[01:22.21]If I could see someone who knew me or someone in uniform
[01:25.67]I go to church on Sunday, truly, usually more"
[01:28.91]Screaming at the angels while they pushed him through the door
[01:32.16]"Abandon all hope, all ye who enter"
[01:35.08]It was a horrifying sign, but sounded like a neat adventure
[01:38.99]Far beyond the halos and the castles in the clouds
[01:42.17]Fatsos squealing, shackled with some apples in their mouths
[01:45.00]Attention whores in padded bras hanging from extension cords
[01:48.73]Tortured with the products from their favorite catalogs
[01:51.91]Here we buy and sell a million kinds of Hell
[01:55.11]Imagination is the limit to the devil's clientele
[01:58.28]Up a dingy elevator, no televised debate
[02:01.10]Will save you from the Hell you paid for, sorry buddy, smell you later
[02:05.25]Side-stepped fate, went right for the gate
[02:08.25]But you know the devil, he loves a good chase
[02:11.25]There was a demon at the entrance, making X's on a checklist
[02:14.85]Who would kick you in the ass when you begged him for repentance
[02:18.19]Those tempted by the senses with the cruelest of intentions
[02:21.42]Charlie's heart sank, he was breathless
[02:24.62]"Excuse me, sir, there must be someone you've confused me for
[02:28.14]If I could see someone who knew me or someone in uniform
[02:31.38]I really don't belong here, I know you've heard the tune before"
[02:34.53]Screaming at the demons while they pushed him through the door
[02:37.90]"Excuse me, sir, there must be someone you've confused me for
[02:41.12]If I could see someone who knew me or someone in uniform
[02:44.53]I really don't belong here, I know you've heard the tune before"
[02:47.88]Screaming at the demons while they pushed him through the door
[02:50.77]You can run from your demons until you are exhausted
[02:54.45]One day, you will have to stop and find out what they wanted
[02:57.49]Keep on running from those demons 'til you are exhausted
[03:03.83]You can run to those angels until you are exhausted
[03:07.67]One day, you will have to stop and question what they wanted
[03:10.76]Keep on running to those angels 'til you are exhausted
[03:17.05]"Excuse me, sir (I don't), there must be someone you've confused me for (want to)
[03:20.73]If I could see someone who knew me or someone in uniform (die)
[03:23.85]I really don't belong here (please don't let me die)
[03:25.64]I know you've heard the tune before"
[03:30.40]"Excuse me, sir (I don't), there must be someone you've confused me for (want to)
[03:33.86]If I could see someone who knew me or someone in uniform (die)
[03:37.17]I really don't belong here (please don't let me die)
[03:38.61]I know you've heard the tune before"
